purpose: Privacy-safe edited copies; original images are not served by the app.

prompts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached screenshot into one privacy-safe instructional image for a website. Keep the original portrait aspect ratio and exact interface geometry, without device frame or outside border. Only bottom-right navigation three dots More button, at about 90% width and 94% height. Red oval tightly around the three dots, red arrow pointing there, label '1. 더보기'. Everything else must be heavily gaussian-blurred: all private financial details, personal identities, status bar time, office surroundings, ads, and unrelated UI. The only sharp content should be the indicated generic clickable control plus its red annotation. Do not reproduce any personal text, names, digits, QR code, photos or balances. This is step 1 of five separate matching images, white/red annotation styling. Preserve the clickable target at its original location. No full original screenshot visible beneath an overlay: blur must be baked into pixels.
